contracts_rationale: Storage and domain only: no HTTP or wire contract is added or changed. The two new pack schemas (contracts/packs/schemas) are pack-file contracts recorded in the plan and ADR-0040, not mission interface contracts.
friendly_name: Glossary pack and skill round trip
purpose_context: Epic #186 brings all Charter Pack content into the service's domain model. This mission (#192) adds the glossary pack and skill kinds: the service reads each glossary pack and each skill with its prompt body, holds them as domain artifacts and writes them back unchanged in meaning, so the whole-pack round-trip gate turns glossary packs from expected red to green and the pack skills round-trip as descriptor-and-body pairs.
purpose_tldr: Every glossary pack and skill in the pinned Charter Packs is read into the service's domain and written back with its meaning intact.
